marks.gloss_en: as Rav Yehuda said that R' Yirmeya bar Abba said, doubtful whether in Rav's or Shmuel's name: three permit the firstborn ...
Rav Yosef: do I learn from everyone? I learn from Rav Yehuda, who repeats even doubts about which man said a thing
RYbRY says two things; Rav and Shmuel agree with him in one and disagree in one (= p_ry_tarti_kaamar)
Rav Yosef: RYbRY says two things; Rav and Shmuel agree with him in one and disagree with him in one
but they said 'he did not say [it]' -- i.e. they spoke of what RYbRY said, not of whether they agree
this is what they mean: the halakha follows him in the large ring and not in the other rings (= the stam's attributions to Rav and Shmuel)
this is what they said: the halakha follows him in the large ring
are you not from the place of Rav and Shmuel? [so how do you eat mugremet?]
who said it [in their name]? Yosef bar Chiyya -- who learns from everyone (= p_rz_yosef_mikulei_alma)
when R' Zeira went up [to Eretz Yisrael] he ate mugremet of Rav and Shmuel's [ban]
and does R' Zeira not hold that one is given the stringencies of the place he left and of the place he went to?
one is given the stringencies of the place he left and the stringencies of the place he went to
not from Bavel to Eretz Yisrael: we are subordinate to them and act as they do
Abaye: that holds from Bavel to Bavel, from Eretz Yisrael to Eretz Yisrael, or from Eretz Yisrael to Bavel -- but not from Bavel to Eretz Yisrael
only where he intends to return, and R' Zeira did not intend to return
Rav Ashi: even from Bavel to Eretz Yisrael -- that holds only where he intends to return
but the rabbis who came from Mechoza say R' Zeira [said] in Rav Nachman's name: mugremet is valid!
each river and its course (= p_nahara_nahara)
R' Zeira in Rav Nachman's name: mugremet is valid
RYbRY (baraita): one who slaughters in the other rings -- though they do not encircle the whole windpipe, since they encircle most of it -- his slaughter is valid
Reish Lakish validated [slaughter] at the tip of the kova
if he left [some] of the chitei -- valid
